test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a constitutional body in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National human rights commission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The National Human Rights Commission** is **NOT **a **constitutional body **in India.
 
• Established in 1993, the **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)** is an autonomous statutory body mandated by the Protection of Human Rights Act of 1993, which was subsequently amended in 2006.
 
• Human rights are an integral component of society, and NHRC plays a pivotal role in safeguarding human rights in India.
 
• Serving as a vigilant guardian, NHRC oversees rights pertaining to life, dignity, liberty, and equality as outlined in Section 2(1) of the PHR Act.
 
• These rights, enshrined in the Constitution of India and upheld by international treaties, are enforceable by Indian courts. The establishment of NHRC aligns with the Paris Principles of Human Rights, 1991, which were adopted to promote and protect human rights.
 
• These principles, endorsed by the United Nations General Assembly in 1993, serve as a guiding framework for NHRC's endeavours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Finance Commissions are periodically** constituted by the President of India under Article 280 of the Indian Constitution to delineate the financial interactions between the central government of India and the respective state governments.
 
• **The State Public Service Commission (SPSC)** is a constitutional entity responsible for administering examinations for state service appointments. Additionally, the SPSC offers guidance to the government on matters related to disciplinary actions and promotions.
 
• **The National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC)** is a constitutional body tasked with safeguarding the interests of scheduled castes in India.
